data.title: 摩根 · 圣枪誓约
data.description: 冬宫的高台上，摩根单手拄着圣枪伦戈米尼亚德，长裙被晚风拂动，冰蓝瞳仁映着天边的最后一缕光——「圣枪之下，我将以这片土地为誓，守护到底。」
data.action: 站在冬宫高台上，一手稳住竖立的圣枪，另一手垂在裙侧，望向余晖
data.camera: full-body shot, upright lance and palace platform visible
data.promptProse: Morgan steadies the upright Rhongomyniad with one hand, the other beside her skirt, watching beyond the battlements. Sunset catches the lance and windblown hem.
data.animaCaption: One hand steadies the upright lance while the other rests beside her skirt.
